messages:
Rina (Docs): Quick ask — drafting migration note for v1->v2 embeddings. Need: tiny Python + curl example using model_id, exact short error text for dim mismatch, and a 1-line changelog sentence for the banner. Keep it very short.

Kevin (SDK): On it — PR reference: github.com/redwood/rdw-sdk/pull/5612. Python snippet you can paste: ```py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$RDW_KEY")
mid = {'embed-old-512':'embed-new-768'}.get('embed-old-512','embed-old-512')
resp = client.embeddings.create(model_id=mid, input=["hi"])
print(len(resp.data[0]['embedding']))
```

Kevin (SDK): Curl one-liner: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $RDW_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model_id":"embed-new-768","input":["x"]}'`

Tom (Runtime): Exact short error payload (trimmed): `\{"error\":\"embedding failed: vector_dim 512 != expected 768\", \"code\":\"ERR_DIM_MISMATCH\"\}`. Use the fragment "embedding failed: vector_dim" in troubleshooting copy. Note: recommend pinning model version for stable vectors across rollouts.

Rina (Docs): Drafting troubleshooting line: "If a 400 mentions 'vector_dim', verify model_id and remap or regenerate vectors; pin model versions for deterministic outputs." Priya  keep this under 120 chars for l10n.

Priya (L10n): Good — I can localize that single sentence if it's in the PR description. Avoid extra punctuation.

Sam (PM): Changelog blurb suggestion: "Embeddings: rename param to model_id (model alias supported); ERR_DIM_MISMATCH on dim mismatch. See migration quickstart." Can that be the console banner?

Kevin (SDK): I'll add the blurb and alias example to the SDK PR.

Tom (Runtime): I'll add a tiny test asserting 400 contains "vector_dim" and drop the CI link here when green.

Rina (Docs): Actions: Kevin adds changelog + README snippet; Tom adds test; Priya queues l10n on merge; Rina will open docs PR with the examples and one-line troubleshooting. Merge when green. :thumbsup:

(End)
